snippet.title: STARNAUT: Full Launch Trailer - Steam
snippet.description:
The acclaimed early access title STARNAUT is finally getting its full release!

・On April 28, 2025, the game will be fully released under the new title: Mythical Concept: STARNAUT.
A massive update will introduce new systems, story content, weapons, and stages!
Experience a tale that connects to El Shaddai!
And best of all — if you already purchased the early access version, the full release will be a free update!

Mythical Concept: STARNAUT is a pick-up-and-play roguelike action game.

・CHOOSE YOUR WEAPON!! Feel the excitement of destroying the infinite amount of enemies!
CHALLENGE TO THE EXTREME!! You will have maximum of 30 minutes to sweep them!
BE CAREFUL!! This game is way too addictive! You may forget the time!

STARANAUT(スターノート) Steamストアページ
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508940/_/
